title: Complete implementation-ready UI direction
objective: Convert every supplied browser annotation into concrete, implementation-ready UI behavior for the finish-first cockpit; preserve FEEDBACK-01..06 data contracts; design only, no source edits or commit.
constraints_honored: Evidence/design only; no source edits, runtime restart, live POST, external writes, or commit.
Calendar accounting overrides are local projection-only and never mutate source events.
Day Setup and Results/SOW are prioritized for reachability and clarity.
FEEDBACK-01..06 behavior is preserved, not re-litigated.
principles: Extend existing seams (CalendarImpact, ActionDock, AllocationPie, Queue, ApprovalDrawer, time.ts); do not add a framework.
Time formatting: add display24h in frontend/src/model/time.ts; replace every display12h call.
Override copy describes planning accounting only ('counted toward capacity'), never attendance or event mutation.
Reachable Results/SOW in every applicable state via ActionDock; Day Setup stays always visible and primary during setup.
Duration rows expose effective value plus source (memory override vs default) for sighted and AT users.
Over/remaining capacity is explicit in normal and over states via AllocationPie readout and dock status.
Action affordances work for pointer, keyboard, and touch (no title-only dependence).
Accessibility floor: 44x44px targets, visible focus, semantic roles, reduced-motion, AA contrast in both themes.

mapped_annotations.feedback: Assigned rows visually overlap fixed calendar blocks; user cannot tell which blocks are hard walls.
mapped_annotations.current_state: CalendarImpact shows class badge + counted blocks but no wall/exclusivity signal; overflow avoidance lives in controller/overflow.ts (FEEDBACK-02/03).
mapped_annotations.mapped_ui_behavior: Render a 'wall' affordance on fixed/work calendar rows (non-permeable); show overflow/infeasible warnings via existing acceptableDefects alerts path. No reorder UI needed.
mapped_annotations.spec: Add calendar-impact__wall badge for capacityClass fixed/work (not ignored/quarantined/window); keep quarantined as 'Not counted'/'0 blk counted' per FEEDBACK-04.

mapped_annotations.feedback: Non-chronological sequence error surfaced as a raw server rejection; user needs it readable in-app.
mapped_annotations.current_state: controller hard errors and acceptableDefects flow to alerts; ActionDock status shows blocking issues.
mapped_annotations.mapped_ui_behavior: Ensure sequence hard errors and 'overflow infeasible' warnings render in the alerts region and gate shadow/commit; status text already names blocking issue count.
mapped_annotations.spec: Keep defectsResolved gate; surface s.validation.hardErrors and defects in a visible alerts list tied to the dock 'fix' state.

mapped_annotations.source: plan covers '24-hour calendar rows'; FF-07 AC 'render 24-hour HH:MM consistently'
mapped_annotations.feedback: Time readouts must be 24-hour, not 12-hour, across calendar and task rows.
mapped_annotations.current_state: time.ts exposes display12h (user preference); CalendarImpact, Queue, ApprovalDrawer, droppedTimeLabel all use display12h.
mapped_annotations.mapped_ui_behavior: Add display24h(hhmm) -> 'HH:MM' (null -> em dash); replace all display12h call sites with display24h.
mapped_annotations.spec: display24h: split HH:MM, return `${hh}:${mm}` zero-padded; wire already 24h so no reparse risk. Keep toHHMM as canonical serializer.

mapped_annotations.source: FF-05 known_context 'CalendarImpact uses 12-hour and Not attending wording'
mapped_annotations.feedback: 'Not attending' implies calendar attendance semantics and source mutation; copy must describe planning accounting.
mapped_annotations.current_state: CalendarImpact button toggles skipToday via controller.saveAnchoredOverride; label 'Not attending'/'Restore'.
mapped_annotations.mapped_ui_behavior: Rename to accounting copy: attending -> 'Exclude from plan' (aria 'Do not count NAME toward today's capacity'); excluded -> 'Count'. Add subtitle 'today only'.
mapped_annotations.spec: Label uses accounting language; reason() stays (Not counted / Fixed / Inside work budget). No change to saveAnchoredOverride signature.

mapped_annotations.source: FF-06 AC 'local duration/accounting override changes planning capacity for that day only'; prior_decision 'Imported calendar events are read-only inputs'
mapped_annotations.feedback: Calendar accounting override must be defined as a local projection-only change, never source event mutation.
mapped_annotations.current_state: saveAnchoredOverride(rowId,{on:true,skipToday,time:null}) is a local override; FF-06 backend keeps event start/end/title/source unchanged.
mapped_annotations.mapped_ui_behavior: Document override as projection-only in UI: when skipToday true, show 'Excluded from plan today' tag; copy states 'changes today's counted capacity only; the calendar event is untouched'.
mapped_annotations.spec: Add calendar-impact__local tag on excluded rows; no writer call implied. Mirrors FF-06 'no event mutation' contract.

mapped_annotations.source: prior_decision assumptions 'Results/SOW names post-sequence surfaces user could not reach'; FF-05 'reachable and understandable Results/SOW'
mapped_annotations.feedback: Results/SOW (ApprovalDrawer commit result / approve writes) was not reachable or understood.
mapped_annotations.current_state: ActionDock exposes 'Open approval' (preview), 'View result' (verified), 'Commit incomplete' (partial); not in review/sequencing; label says 'Approve today's writes'/'Commit result'.
mapped_annotations.mapped_ui_behavior: Prioritize a persistent 'Results' button reachable in review, preview, verified, partial; relabel to 'Results' / 'Statement of work' for clarity; keep two-gate live commit inside drawer.
mapped_annotations.spec: Dock: add Results button when s.shadow || s.commitReport exists; title 'Review exact writes and commit result'. Drawer h2: 'Results' (committed) / 'Preview writes' (review) / 'Approve writes' (arm).

mapped_annotations.source: FF-05 known_context 'Day Setup and View result exist but were not reachable or understood'
mapped_annotations.feedback: Day Setup access must be prominent and primary in the unconfirmed state.
mapped_annotations.current_state: ActionDock 'Day setup' button always visible; primary styling only in setup state.
mapped_annotations.mapped_ui_behavior: Keep Day setup always visible and primary during setup; add aria-label 'Open day setup' and a 'setup not confirmed' hint while state==setup. No relocation.
mapped_annotations.spec: Preserve openSetup dispatch; ensure 44px target and visible label in all states.

mapped_annotations.source: FF-07 AC 'Duration rows show effective value and whether memory or another source won'
mapped_annotations.feedback: User cannot tell if a row duration is a memory override or the source/default value.
mapped_annotations.current_state: Row shows blocksLabel(blocks) with '*' when overridden; no explicit source label.
mapped_annotations.mapped_ui_behavior: Show effective duration value plus a source chip: 'memory' when s.overrides[id].blocks != null, else 'source'. Expose via aria-valuetext and a visible chip.
mapped_annotations.spec: Add qrow__src-tag 'memory' | 'source' beside alloc-track__value; aria-valuetext = `${blocksLabel(blocks)} (${source})`. Keep '*' marker as redundant signal.

mapped_annotations.source: FF-07 AC 'Overflow and remaining capacity are explicit in normal and over-capacity states'
mapped_annotations.feedback: Over-assignment can be hidden by overflow tail or read as a blocking defect.
mapped_annotations.current_state: AllocationPie center readout shows 'X over' / 'Y remaining'; dock status shows spend/budget.
mapped_annotations.mapped_ui_behavior: Keep pie readout explicit; when over>0 add 'Over by X blk - trim or drop' caption using --c-overflow token; dock status keeps 'X of Y blk'. Overflow warnings from FEEDBACK-03 render in alerts.
mapped_annotations.spec: pie__readout over-state already present; add pie__over-caption when over>0. Keep live region aria-live=polite.

mapped_annotations.source: later_polish LP-01 'critical-band wording and stronger remaining-item hierarchy'
mapped_annotations.feedback: Remaining/over-capacity items need a stronger visual hierarchy, not buried in bands.
mapped_annotations.current_state: BandHeader shows share/over per band; over-capacity only in pie.
mapped_annotations.mapped_ui_behavior: Add a 'Remaining / Over capacity' summary line above bands when total selected exceeds capacity; use --c-overflow for over. Keep band notes concise.
mapped_annotations.spec: queue__remaining summary: 'X blk selected of Y capacity - Z over' with strong weight; collapses to within-share when balanced.

mapped_annotations.feedback: Collapsed bands hide rows with only a chevron; state is unclear to sighted and AT users.
mapped_annotations.current_state: BandHeader/DroppedHeader use chevron + count; aria-expanded present but no 'hidden' wording.
mapped_annotations.mapped_ui_behavior: When collapsed, show 'Collapsed - N rows hidden' text and aria-label 'Band NAME, collapsed, N rows hidden, activate to expand'; expanded shows 'N rows'.
mapped_annotations.spec: Add band__state text node driven by open; keep aria-controls/aria-expanded; announce hidden count to AT.

mapped_annotations.source: later_polish LP-02 'action tooltip or popover affordances' + LP-01 'without title-only dependence'
mapped_annotations.feedback: Action explanations rely on title tooltips (pointer only); keyboard and touch users get nothing.
mapped_annotations.current_state: StagingVerbs/MoreMenu/row icon buttons use title attributes only.
mapped_annotations.mapped_ui_behavior: Provide a focus+hover popover (Tooltip component) for every action button; keep aria-label as the AT equivalent; touch shows popover on focus. Visible text labels preferred for high-frequency verbs.
mapped_annotations.spec: Add shared Tooltip wrapper: onFocus/onMouseEnter shows label; respects prefers-reduced-motion; theme-safe surface token.

mapped_annotations.source: later_polish LP-03 'simplify overlapping actions and clarify opaque More menu'
mapped_annotations.feedback: Row action cluster (exclude, duration, place, unschedule, Done, Drop, More) overlaps and is noisy.
mapped_annotations.current_state: Row actions: exclude, duration, place (conditional), unschedule (conditional), divider, Done, Drop, More(Unassign/Delete).
mapped_annotations.mapped_ui_behavior: Keep Done/Drop direct (frozen verb model). Group shape actions: keep exclude + duration on row; move place/unschedule into More menu. Add a visible text label to Done/Drop at >=720px width, icon-only below.
mapped_annotations.spec: Move place/unschedule menuitems into MORE_VERBS; keep DIRECT_VERBS = done, drop. No new product verbs; side effects unchanged.
mapped_annotations.preserves_feedback: FF-07/LP-02 'no new product actions'; Done/Drop/Unassign/Delete contracts intact

mapped_annotations.source: later_polish LP-03 'opaque More menu' + LP-02 'theme-safe layering'
mapped_annotations.feedback: More menu layering is not opaque/readable across light and dark themes.
mapped_annotations.current_state: row-more__menu uses surface token but no explicit border/shadow/z-index in both themes.
mapped_annotations.mapped_ui_behavior: Style menu with --t-surface background, --t-border, elevated z-index, and shadow; ensure >=4.5:1 text contrast in both themes; menu items keep text labels (Unassign, Delete).
mapped_annotations.spec: Add menu elevation token; verify contrast; keep aria-haspopup/menu/expanded/controls and Escape refocus.

mapped_annotations.feedback: Band note wording should be concise and must not change urgency semantics.
mapped_annotations.current_state: Band notes derive from BANDS spec in model/bands.ts.
mapped_annotations.mapped_ui_behavior: Keep Critical/High/Else tiers; tighten band.note copy to one clause; do not alter urgency tier logic.
mapped_annotations.spec: Notes: Critical 'do today', High 'soon', Else 'when room'. No semantic change to banding.

time_ts.add: display24h(hhmm: string|null): string -> HH:MM zero-padded; null/empty -> em dash
time_ts.remove_usage: display12h retained for fallback only; no new call sites

CalendarImpact_tsx.override_aria: attending -> 'Do not count NAME toward today's capacity'; excluded -> 'Count NAME toward capacity'
CalendarImpact_tsx.wall_badge: capacityClass fixed|work -> calendar-impact__wall 'hard block'; ignored|quarantined|window -> none
CalendarImpact_tsx.local_tag: skipToday -> calendar-impact__local 'Excluded from plan today (event untouched)'

ActionDock_tsx.day_setup: always visible; primary in setup; aria-label 'Open day setup'
ActionDock_tsx.results: persistent 'Results' button when s.shadow || s.commitReport; labels: review='Preview writes', preview/verified/partial='Results'
ActionDock_tsx.status: keep spend/budget and blocking-issue counts; add over-capacity phrasing from capacity.remaining
ActionDock_tsx.preserve: Copy prompt fallback, Auto sequence (1 billed) gating, Accept as-is, Preview commit unchanged

AllocationPie_tsx.over_caption: when over>0 add 'Over by X blk - trim or drop' with --c-overflow
AllocationPie_tsx.preserve: slice inspection, legend buttons, hatch for buffer/unallocated

Queue_tsx.duration_source: qrow__src-tag 'memory'|'source' beside value; aria-valuetext includes source
Queue_tsx.remaining_summary: queue__remaining line above bands when selected>capacity
Queue_tsx.actions: Done/Drop direct; place/unschedule moved to More; Tooltip popover on focus+hover; text labels at >=720px
Queue_tsx.more_menu: opaque surface token, border, shadow, z-index; text labels Unassign/Delete
Queue_tsx.preserve: BANDS tiers, keyboard nav, 44px floor, all-day visibility

ApprovalDrawer_tsx.labels: h2 'Results' (committed) / 'Preview writes' (review) / 'Approve writes' (arm); keep two-gate live commit
ApprovalDrawer_tsx.preserve: SurfaceTotals, Blockers, Exact writes disclosure, verify list

feedback_01_06_preservation.FEEDBACK-01: Chronological order enforced in controller.sort(byStartThenId); UI shows hard errors via alerts (A02). No UI reorder.
feedback_01_06_preservation.FEEDBACK-02: Hard walls: CalendarImpact wall badge (A01); overflow avoids walls in controller/overflow.ts.
feedback_01_06_preservation.FEEDBACK-03: Explicit infeasibility warnings render in alerts; AllocationPie over readout (A09).
feedback_01_06_preservation.FEEDBACK-05: Scenario parity maintained; over-assignment readout explicit (A09/A10).
feedback_01_06_preservation.FEEDBACK-06: Zero calendar writer calls; override copy never implies mutation (A04/A05).

open_decisions.question: Exact label for the calendar local override action: 'Exclude from plan' vs 'Do not count today' vs 'Skip'.
open_decisions.impact: A04/A05 copy; needs user wording choice before FF-07 implementation.

open_decisions.question: Should Results/SOW be reachable pre-sequence (review state) or only after a shadow preview exists?
open_decisions.impact: A06 reachability scope; current spec shows it when s.shadow exists (post-sequence).

open_decisions.question: Duration-source chip placement within the 44px row floor: inline chip vs prefix vs aria-only.
open_decisions.impact: A08 layout; inline chip chosen in spec but width-constrained rows may need aria-only at narrow widths.

open_decisions.question: Place/Unschedule: move fully into More menu (simpler row) vs keep conditional icons on row.
open_decisions.impact: A13 action simplification; spec moves them to More to reduce row noise.

open_decisions.question: 24-hour user-facing format: strict HH:MM (matches wire) vs H:MM.
open_decisions.impact: A03; spec uses HH:MM to match server contract and avoid reparse.

open_decisions.question: Where the over-capacity summary lives: dedicated queue__remaining line (A10) vs rely on AllocationPie only.
open_decisions.impact: A10/A09; spec adds a line above bands for scan-distance hierarchy.

a11y_checklist: Override copy describes accounting, not attendance/mutation (A04/A05).
Results/SOW reachable by keyboard and pointer in applicable states (A06).
Duration source exposed to AT via aria-valuetext (A08).
Over/remaining explicit in normal and over states (A09/A10).
Collapsed bands announce hidden count to AT (A11).
Action affordances on focus+hover, not title-only (A12).
Reduced-motion respected for any new transitions; semantic HTML/ARIA preserved.
acceptance_criteria_met: Artifact exists and is valid JSON (this file).
Every supplied annotation (A01..A15) is mapped or explicitly classified (open decisions OD1..OD6).
Design is implementation-ready: component specs cite real files, props, and tokens; FEEDBACK-01..06 behavior preserved.
No source/live changes: design handoff only; no edit, restart, POST, commit.

safety_proof.branch_or_index_mutation: none - no commit, stage, reset, clean, stash, rebase, or merge
safety_proof.foreign_changes_preserved: tracked dirty work untouched; only FEEDBACK-07 evidence file written under docs/plan/2026-08-12-tdtb-feedback-follow-up/evidence/
